SELECT gto.*, v.license_plate AS vehicle_name, gt.name AS garbage_type_name, gc.plan_no AS plan_no, IFNULL(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.point_name SEPARATOR ','), '') AS points_name_str FROM garbage_transfer_operation gto LEFT JOIN sys_vehicle v ON gto.vehicle_id = v.sys_vehicle_id AND v.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_garbage_type gt ON gto.garbage_type_id = gt.sys_garbage_type_id AND gt.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN garbage_collection gc ON gto.plan_id = gc.collection_id AND gc.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN point p ON FIND_IN_SET(p.point_id, REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(gc.point_ids, '[', ''), ']', ''), '"', ''), ' ', '') ) AND p.deleted = 0
GROUP BY gto.id, v.license_plate, gt.name, gc.plan_no ORDER BY gto.id DESC LIMIT #{reqVO.offset}, #{reqVO.pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT gto.id) FROM garbage_transfer_operation gto
